name: Onzai Momotarou
source:
He doesn't have a lot of facial expressions and is taciturn, but he is compassionate and good at reading people's subtleties. He supports the other members from the shadows. He has no prejudices or likes and dislikes.

While he has the depth to accept everyone for who they are, he also sees himself from a bird's-eye view.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bprogame.com/member/#onzaimomotaro]official website[/url]]
